{"notes": "VISIT 5 (6:45-7:15). Table: every domino in the picture is dark and on-chain, from START through the nose, top arc, body, belly, forked tail and tail loop. The stray curl is gone and I see no pale dominoes. I still never saw anyone's hands, so all credit is from self-reports and cross-checks. Hands-off since 6:45.

Priya: Volunteered privately that the curl above the nose was her own unplanned addition and that Maya removed it. That is honest and costs her credit. Her 'fully connected' status matches the table. She says she carried the top line and belly up to the nose and bridged the joint, which matches the nose finishing from 'about halfway' last visit. Her belly claim overlaps Maya's, so ask who built what. She stayed hands-off and gave credit to Leo and Tom. Good late discipline, but she created the curl problem, so ask whether she checked (4,10).

Maya: Said publicly and privately that she cleared the curl and checked the nose joint. The curl is gone, which is consistent, and Priya confirms it. Clear communication and attention to the final look. She also claims the belly, which overlaps Priya's claim. I need to confirm she did the removal and what she built.

Tom: Silent this visit. Priya and Leo both credit him with the tail handoff, and the tail is connected, which supports his earlier claim. Cautious and low-visibility. Ask which dominoes he placed.

Leo: Says he coordinated and will do a final nose and tail check. Priya says he kept everyone coordinated, and his status was accurate. Still no physical output seen. Ask what he built and whether the final check happened.

Review: Ask each person who built or fixed what, and resolve the belly overlap. Don't rate on the final result alone."}
